body: See [this source file](https://github.com/rollup/rollup/blob/master/src/utils/sourceMappingURL.js) for how Rollup circumvents this issue; and where it [introduces it](https://github.com/rollup/rollup/blob/master/src/Module.js#L71-L76).
Do you consider this a bug?
I think it is, and the same applies to any other tools that indiscriminately remove all occurrences of that string.

[Check this out.](http://rollupjs.org/?version=0.36.0&) Even if it's really a comment, the regular expression has a `\s` in the middle of it, which will match the end of a multiline string.
